mapper.select: SELECT IF(count(user_code) = 0, 'pass', mb_check_success) as advance_req_check FROM MONEYBANK_ADVANCE_REQUEST_CHECK WHERE (input_date, user_code) IN(SELECT MAX(input_date), user_code FROM MONEYBANK_ADVANCE_REQUEST_CHECK WHERE user_code = #{user_code}) AND input_date >= DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00')

SELECT result_tb.*, IF(CONCAT(mb_business_period, mb_business_type, mb_individual, mb_sales_amount, mb_user_age, mb_duplicate_check) = 'YYYYYY', 'Y', 'N') as mb_check_success FROM ( SELECT user_code, IF(firm_setup_date <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), 'Y', 'N') as mb_business_period, IF(sectors != '13', 'Y', 'N') as mb_business_type, IF(business_type = '1', 'Y', 'N') as mb_individual, 'Y' as mb_sales_amount, IF(#{mb_user_age} >= 20, 'Y', 'N') as mb_user_age, IF(user_type != '02', 'Y', 'N') as mb_duplicate_check FROM CBCI_USER WHERE user_code = #{user_code}) result_tb
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MONEYBANK_ADVANCE_REQUEST_CHECK( user_code, mb_business_period, mb_business_type, mb_individual, mb_sales_amount, mb_user_age, mb_duplicate_check, mb_check_success, input_date )VALUES( #{user_code}, #{mb_business_period}, #{mb_business_type}, #{mb_individual}, #{mb_sales_amount}, #{mb_user_age}, #{mb_duplicate_check}, #{mb_check_success}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(mbid) FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST WHERE mbid like concat(#{value}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST( mbid, user_code, mb_product_code, mb_status, reg_no_first, reg_no_second, mb_sales_amount, input_date ) VALUES ( #{mbid}, #{user_code}, #{mb_product_code}, '00', #{reg_no_first}, #{reg_no_second}, #{mb_sales_amount}, now() )
mapper.select: select ca.SHOP_ID , ca.SHOP_TYPE , cc.CODE_E_NM from CBCI_ACCOUNT ca left join CBCI_CODE cc on ca.SHOP_TYPE = cc.CODE_ID where ca.USER_CODE = #{userCode} and cc.CODE_E_NM IN #{type}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST_SHOP ( mbid, mb_request_shop, mb_request_shop_type, mb_request_shop_id, input_date )VALUES( #{mbid}, #{mb_request_shop}, #{mb_request_shop_type}, #{mb_request_shop_id}, now() )
mapper.select: SELECT mbid, IF(count(mbid) = 1, 'true', 'false') as isAdvanceRequest FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST WHERE mb_status IN ('00') AND user_code = #{value}

SELECT MUR.mbid, MUR.user_code, MUR.mb_product_code, MUR.mb_status, MUR.mb_request_date, MUR.mb_contract_date, (SELECT bank_name FROM CBCI_BANK_CODE WHERE bank_code = mb_demand_acc_bank_code) AS mb_demand_acc_bank_code, MUR.mb_demand_acc_number, MUR.mb_demand_acc_holder, (SELECT bank_name FROM CBCI_BANK_CODE WHERE bank_code = mb_main_acc_bank_code) AS mb_main_acc_bank_code, MUR.mb_main_acc_number, MUR.mb_main_acc_holder, MM.fee_rate, MM.payment_rate, (MM.sales_limit_per_case / 1000) AS sales_limit_per_case FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST MUR LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_MONEYPLUS MM ON MUR.mbid = MM.mbid WHERE MUR.user_code = #{user_code} ORDER BY MUR.mb_request_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update:
UPDATE MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST MUR SET
mb_request_date = now(), mb_demand_acc_bank_code = #{mb_demand_acc_bank_code}, mb_demand_acc_holder = #{mb_demand_acc_holder}, mb_demand_acc_number = #{mb_demand_acc_number}, mb_main_acc_bank_code = #{mb_main_acc_bank_code}, mb_main_acc_holder = #{mb_main_acc_holder}, mb_main_acc_number = #{mb_main_acc_number},
mb_agree_date = now(),
mb_status = LPAD(#{changeStatus}, '2', '0'), upd_date = now() WHERE MUR.mbid = #{mbid}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM ( SELECT mrp.mbid, '입금' AS status, mrp.calculate_deposit_date AS calc_date, mrp.calculate_deposit_amount, '' AS act_principal FROM MONEYBANK_REDEM_PROVISION mrp WHERE mrp.mbid = #{mbid} AND DATE_FORMAT(mrp.calculate_deposit_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{fromDate} AND mrp.calculate_deposit_date <= #{toDate} UNION SELECT mrc.mbid, '상환', mrd.deposit_date, 0, mrc.act_principal FROM MONEYBANK_REDEM_CALCULATE mrc LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_REDEM_DEPOSIT mrd ON mrc.settlement_code = mrd.settlement_code WHERE mrc.mbid = #{mbid} AND DATE_FORMAT(mrd.deposit_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{fromDate} AND mrd.deposit_date <= #{toDate} GROUP BY mrc.settlement_code ) result_tb
WHERE result_tb.status IN (#{status})
ORDER BY result_tb.calc_date desc
